Welcome to the Department of Statistics at UW–Madison
The Department of Statistics is a hub for statistics and data science research and education. A founding department of the College of Computing & Artificial Intelligence, we are proud to be considered one of the premier statistics departments in the nation and the home of some of the fastest-growing programs at UW–Madison.
We harness statistics and data science to tackle interdisciplinary challenges, and our renowned faculty and staff prepare the next generation of data-driven leaders for in-demand careers across a wide range of sectors.
